about.title: About this game
about.intro: Still Out There mixes a made-up story with real records. The two kinds of text look different, so you can always tell them apart.
about.story: Text in a cyan frame with this tag is part of the made-up story. The robot, its messages and the echoes are not real.
about.record: Text in an amber frame with this tag is from the Archive. Each record lists its sources and the date a person last checked it.
about.privacy: This game has no accounts, no ads and no tracking. It keeps your progress and settings only in this browser.

save.notice: Your browser is blocking storage, so your progress will not be kept after you leave this page.
